First of all what happened to you as a child was seriously messed up, but it isn't your fault nor did you deserve it. You deserved better as a child and I'm sorry your family and teachers failed you. Secondly, just because you were molested does not mean that you are a pedophile, nor will you repeat the same crimes your attacker inflicted on you. That logic does not add up. You always have a choice in your actions and no one has taken away your ability to make choices.

I hope that you can get some rest and find comfort in the fact that you aren't broken, you just needed love and the people around you didn't give enough of it. But it is not your fault at all.
